headline: AFT Pharmaceutical Reports Doubled Half-Year Net Profit
summary: AFT Pharmaceutical announced that its half-year net profit for the period ended September more than doubled compared to the previous year, rising to $6.9 million.
why: Pharmaceutical manufacturing earnings growth reflects successful product commercialization and expanding international distribution channels.
